name: Shenzhou 24
location_str: Launch Area 91 (SLS-1 / 921) @ Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center, CHN
destination_explanation: Most of the satellites working today are down here, which has made this by far the most crowded stretch of space around the planet.
slot_a_text: Shenzhou 24 will be the 24th flight of the Shenzhou program. The first astronaut from Pakistan, Muhammad Zeeshan Ali, will fly on this on a short duration mission, with Chinese astronaut Zhu Yangzhu of Shenzhou 23 to undergo a year long expedition and stay on the CSS in exchange.
slot_b_text: Shenzhou 24 carried a crew of three: commander Tang Hongbo and operators Muhammad Zeeshan Ali and Wu Yi.
